_about: F2 client fixture, written to the contract in docs/plans/briefs/f2_play.md (view["places"]) until the engine half (tools/places_view.py) lands. The Curia's and the Treasury's proposals, costs and forecasts are copied from the real view["republic"]["proposals"] of a headless rome_264 game (seed 1); the consuls, tribunes and candidates are that game's people. Actions of kinds the engine does not know yet (contio, vow, games, levy, expiate) are answered by the engine with an error until the engine half lands. `events` are the year's city events the --moments test flag plays (the engine's city-event shape). Historical colour: the first munus at Rome, given by the sons of D. Iunius Brutus Pera in the Forum Boarium in 264 BC (Livy Per. 16; Val. Max. 2.4.7); M. Fulvius Flaccus' triumph over the Volsinians, 264 BC (Fasti Triumphales); the colony of Firmum in Picenum, 264 BC (Vell. Pat. 1.14.8).

curia_hostilia.title: Curia Hostilia
curia_hostilia.blurb: Where the Senate meets this year. Put a matter to the fathers, win a family over, and watch the division.

forecast.note: no tribune will act: the house is of one mind

actions.label: Propose: a law to ease debt

forecast.note: Gaius Calvisius may carry it to the people over the Senate's refusal (15% chance)
Gaius Calvisius may carry it to the people over the Senate's refusal (15% chance)
no tribune will act: the losing side is not the more popular one

actions.label: Propose: the Latin right for the Etruscan and Faliscan cities

forecast.note: a knife-edge: one family's change of mind turns it
the Claudii lean further for war: the next war vote gains their men

actions.label: Propose: peace with Carthage
actions.why: Rome is not at war with Carthage

info.label: Your influence
info.tip: Spent to put matters to the Senate (200-300), persuade a family (150) or back a candidate (250).

info.label: Presiding
info.tip: The consul who lays matters before the house (relatio).

info.label: The house
info.tip: One bloc in 264 BC: the patricio-plebeian nobility.

rostra_republic.title: Rostra
rostra_republic.blurb: The speakers' platform with the beaks of the ships of Antium. Address the people (contio) for a law or a man.

actions.label: Address the people: for war with Carthage

forecast.note: from a consul's mouth: the people's favour for war rises about 6%

actions.label: Address the people: for the agrarian law

forecast.note: the plebs want land: a tribune's speech would carry further still

info.label: Speaker
info.tip: A consul's or a tribune's speech carries furthest.

comitium.title: Comitium
comitium.blurb: The tribes vote here: the plebeian assembly elects the tribunes and the aediles.

actions.label: Back Decimus Iunius Brutus for aedile

forecast.note: his chance at the next election rises; an aedile gives the games

info.label: Assembly
info.tip: Each tribe casts one vote, the majority of its members deciding.

campus_martius.title: Campus Martius
campus_martius.blurb: The field of Mars: the centuries vote for consuls here, and the army musters.

actions.label: Back Aulus Atilius Regulus for consul

forecast.note: the first class votes first: a man the knights favour is half elected
about 8,400 citizens of the census classes and their allies are enrolled

info.label: Census
info.tip: The census of 264 BC in this game.

aedes_saturni.title: Temple of Saturn (Aerarium)
aedes_saturni.blurb: The state treasury lies under the temple's podium. Fund a work from it, with the Senate's leave.

info.label: Treasury
info.tip: Wealth in the aerarium (the engine's stores).

info.label: Income
info.tip: Tributum, rents of public land, harbour dues (fixture).

info.label: Spending
info.tip: The legions' pay, works, the games (fixture).

aedes_iovis_capitolini.title: Temple of Jupiter Optimus Maximus
aedes_iovis_capitolini.blurb: The Capitol's great temple: vows are made here before a war and kept after it.

actions.label: Vow a temple for victory over Carthage

forecast.note: the gods' favour rises; a won war obliges you to build the temple

actions.label: Expiate a prodigy
actions.why: No prodigy has been reported this year

actions.label: Consult the Sibylline Books
actions.why: Only on the Senate's order, in a crisis (the decemviri)

circus_maximus.title: Circus Maximus
circus_maximus.blurb: The Ludi Romani run here each September. An aedile who gives fine games wins the people.

actions.label: Give the Roman Games as aedile

forecast.note: popular favour and your family's standing rise

info.label: Next games
info.tip: Livy 1.35.9: the games of Tarquin, kept every year.

forum_boarium.title: Forum Boarium
forum_boarium.blurb: The cattle market by the river: in 264 BC the first gladiators at Rome fought here, at a funeral.

actions.label: Give a munus for D. Iunius Brutus Pera

forecast.note: three pairs of gladiators, as his sons gave (Livy Per. 16)

navalia.title: Navalia
navalia.blurb: The shipsheds on the Tiber. The shipwrights would listen to an idea about ships.

actions.label: Whisper an idea to the shipwrights

forecast.note: opens the idea box: the shipwrights hear it
